summary: The gate's open-blocker violation (review_gate.rs open_blocker_violation) still tells whoever reads 'canon gate check' to 'fix it and finding close ... --disposition fixed, or close it as rejected or deferred', with no word on who. An implementer or orchestrator that follows it gets FINDING_ROLE_DENIED (verified: CANON_ROLE=implementer finding close --disposition rejected on the gate's blocker). Say 'a reviewer closes it rejected or deferred' there. Blast radius: the same text is in every gate check, status and ship refusal that lists an open blocker; the refusal's own hint (leave it to a reviewer, run it with --as reviewer) is right.
